chunks: And from him, from Hassan, from 'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Until when is the 'Umrah valid for the pilgrim?' He said, and he said: 'Until the dawn (subah) of the Night of 'Arafah.'
ai.seo_question: When does the 'Umrah of the pilgrim expire during Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the temporal boundary for performing 'Umrah al-Mufradah while in the state of Ihram for Hajj, ruling it valid until the dawn of the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah (Night of 'Arafah). This establishes the critical juncture where the pilgrim must either proceed directly to Mina for the main Hajj rituals or perform 'Umrah to complete the seven circumambulations before the Hajj rites commence, reflecting the jurisprudential distinction between the two acts of worship.
